---
title: "ARI_Revision_Figure"
output: html_document
date: "2026-10-28"
---

This script was written to address T. Girke comment on the manuscript, "Explore the weaker ARI responses. For compounds with few individually significant ARI changes, could a combined analysis (focus on logFC without FDR) reveal a consistent response across several indicators? This might help distinguish a weak but coordinated response from no clear response. A plot of changes with confidence intervals could also help show whether these results reflect small effects or substantial uncertainty."

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

 Approach:
   1. Score each ARI per sample (gene ARIs = logCPM; pathway ARIs = mean z-score
      across signature genes, as in Figure 2b-c).
   2. Estimate each compound's effect on each ARI vs vehicle with
      lm(value ~ treatment + line), reported with 95% CI and NO FDR filter.
   3. Standardize each effect by that indicator's residual SD and sign-align it
      so that positive = slow-aging direction for every indicator.
   4. Build a per-sample composite ARI score (mean of aligned, standardized
      indicators) and test it with the same model, giving one effect +/- CI
      per compound. Done for all six ARIs and for the four transcript-level
      ARIs alone (so mTORC1 / MEK-ERK do not dominate).
   5. Count how many indicators move in the slow-aging direction (sign test).
   6. Classify each compound: coordinated slow-aging / coordinated opposite /
      no detectable response (CI inside +/- margin) / uncertain (CI wide).

 Outputs (in out_dir):
   FigS_ARI_forest_standardized.png/.pdf  per-indicator effects, 95% CI
   FigS_ARI_forest_native_units.png/.pdf  same, in log2FC / score units
   FigS_ARI_composite.png/.pdf             composite effect per compound
   ARI_indicator_effects.csv, ARI_composite_effects.csv
   
   
#0 -- Setup 

```{r}
setwd("/restricted/projectnb/crem-trainees/Murphy_Lab/Elise/GeroScreen_Paper")
 
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
})
 
out_dir <- "ARI_combined"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
 
base_font <- "sans"     # Arial is not available on the SCC
 
## Equivalence margin (in residual-SD units) used to call "no detectable
## response": the whole 95% CI must sit inside +/- this value.
## 0.5 SD is a conventional "small effect" boundary; change if you prefer.
equiv_margin <- 0.5
 
logcpm_raw <- read.csv("26_01_29_logcpm.csv", check.names = FALSE,
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
 
annot_cols  <- c("gene_key", "gene_id", "symbol", "feature_name",
                 "Length", "gene_biotype")
sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(logcpm_raw), annot_cols)
```

#1 -- Sample meta data (same as other scripts for this manuscript)

```{r}
group_levels <- c("CTRL", "RUT", "SIT", "GEN", "EBS", "CAL", "PI", "TRA", "RAP")
full_names   <- c(CTRL = "Vehicle", RUT = "Rutin", SIT = "Sitagliptin",
                  GEN = "Genistein", EBS = "Ebselen", CAL = "Calpeptin",
                  PI = "PI-103", TRA = "Trametinib", RAP = "Rapamycin")
treatments   <- setdiff(group_levels, "CTRL")
 
meta <- data.frame(sample = sample_cols, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(line  = factor(sub("_.*$", "", sample)),
         cond  = sub("^[^_]+_", "", sample),
         group = factor(sub("[0-9]+$", "", cond), levels = group_levels),
         label = factor(full_names[as.character(group)],
                        levels = full_names[group_levels]))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(meta$group)))
 
## Okabe-Ito, grey for vehicle (identical to Figures 1-2)
group_cols <- setNames(c("grey55", "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442",
                         "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7", "#000000"),
                       full_names[group_levels])
```

#2 -- Expression matrix

```{r}
expr_df <- logcpm_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(symbol), symbol != "") %>%
  mutate(row_mean = rowMeans(across(all_of(sample_cols)))) %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  slice_max(row_mean, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
 
expr <- as.matrix(expr_df[, meta$sample])
rownames(expr) <- expr_df$symbol
```

#3 -- Theme and save helped (same as previous scripts for this manuscript)

```{r}
theme_fig <- theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = base_font) +
  theme(axis.text        = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.line        = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
        axis.ticks       = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.key.size  = unit(0.35, "cm"),
        plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
 
save_fig <- function(p, name, w, h) {
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = w, height = h,
         units = "in", dpi = 600, device = png, type = "cairo")
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), p, width = w, height = h,
         units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
}
```

#4 -- Define ARI parametrs 

```{r}
## direction = +1 if the slow-aging state is an INCREASE, -1 if a DECREASE
## (Austad, Kaeberlein & Miller 2026; Figure 2 legend).
gene_aris <- data.frame(
  indicator = c("DCX", "BDNF", "FNDC5", "GPLD1", "UCP1"),
  direction = c(+1, +1, +1, +1, +1),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
missing_genes <- setdiff(gene_aris$indicator, rownames(expr))
if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
  message("Not expressed / filtered, skipped: ",
          paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", "))
}
gene_aris <- filter(gene_aris, indicator %in% rownames(expr))
 
## MEK-ERK: 10-gene MAPK Pathway Activity Score (Wagle et al. 2018)
mpas_genes <- c("PHLDA1", "SPRY2", "SPRY4", "DUSP4", "DUSP6",
                "CCND1", "EPHA2", "EPHA4", "ETV4", "ETV5")
 
## mTORC1: MSigDB Hallmark mTORC1 signalling (same set as Figure 2b)
if (!requireNamespace("msigdbr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("msigdbr is needed for the Hallmark mTORC1 set (as in Figure 2b).")
}
hm <- tryCatch(
  msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H"),
  error = function(e) msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H")
)
mtorc1_genes <- unique(hm$gene_symbol[hm$gs_name == "HALLMARK_MTORC1_SIGNALING"])
 
pathway_score <- function(genes) {
  g <- intersect(genes, rownames(expr))
  message(sprintf("  %d of %d signature genes found", length(g), length(genes)))
  z <- t(scale(t(expr[g, , drop = FALSE])))   # z-score each gene across samples
  colMeans(z, na.rm = TRUE)
}
 
message("MEK-ERK (MPAS):");  mek_score    <- pathway_score(mpas_genes)
message("mTORC1 (Hallmark):"); mtorc1_score <- pathway_score(mtorc1_genes)
```

#5 -- Per sample indicators 

```{r}
ari_long <- bind_rows(
  lapply(gene_aris$indicator, function(g)
    data.frame(sample = meta$sample, indicator = g, value = expr[g, meta$sample])),
  data.frame(sample = meta$sample, indicator = "mTORC1",  value = mtorc1_score[meta$sample]),
  data.frame(sample = meta$sample, indicator = "MEK-ERK", value = mek_score[meta$sample])
) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "sample")
 
ari_info <- bind_rows(
  gene_aris %>% mutate(class = "Transcript-level"),
  data.frame(indicator = c("mTORC1", "MEK-ERK"), direction = c(-1, -1),
             class = "Pathway-level")
)
ari_levels <- ari_info$indicator
ari_long   <- left_join(ari_long, ari_info, by = "indicator")
```

#6 -- Per indicator effects vs. vehicle, no FDR, 95% CI

```{r}
fit_indicator <- function(d) {
  d$group <- relevel(droplevels(d$group), ref = "CTRL")
  fit <- lm(value ~ group + line, data = d)
  co  <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  ci  <- confint(fit)
  rows <- paste0("group", treatments)
  data.frame(group     = treatments,
             estimate  = co[rows, "Estimate"],
             se        = co[rows, "Std. Error"],
             lower     = ci[rows, 1],
             upper     = ci[rows, 2],
             p_nominal = co[rows, "Pr(>|t|)"],
             resid_sd  = sigma(fit),
             df        = fit$df.residual)
}
 
ind_eff <- ari_long %>%
  group_by(indicator, direction, class) %>%
  group_modify(~ fit_indicator(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    ## standardized and sign-aligned: + = slow-aging direction, in SD units
    std_est   = direction * estimate / resid_sd,
    std_lower = direction * ifelse(direction > 0, lower, upper) / resid_sd,
    std_upper = direction * ifelse(direction > 0, upper, lower) / resid_sd,
    label     = factor(full_names[group], levels = full_names[treatments]),
    indicator = factor(indicator, levels = ari_levels),
    nominal_sig = p_nominal < 0.05
  )
 
write.csv(ind_eff, file.path(out_dir, "ARI_indicator_effects.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

#7 -- Composite ARI score per sample

```{r}
## For each indicator: centre on the vehicle mean within each line, divide by the
## indicator's residual SD, multiply by direction. Composite = mean across
## indicators within a sample. Fitting the composite per sample (rather than
## averaging the effect estimates) keeps the correlation between indicators
## inside the uncertainty estimate.
sd_lookup <- ind_eff %>% distinct(indicator, resid_sd) %>%
  mutate(indicator = as.character(indicator))
 
ari_std <- ari_long %>%
  group_by(indicator, line) %>%
  mutate(veh_mean = mean(value[group == "CTRL"])) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(sd_lookup, by = "indicator") %>%
  mutate(aligned = direction * (value - veh_mean) / resid_sd)
 
composite_sets <- list(
  "All ARIs"              = ari_levels,
  "Transcript-level ARIs" = gene_aris$indicator
)
 
comp_eff <- bind_rows(lapply(names(composite_sets), function(nm) {
  inds <- composite_sets[[nm]]
  per_sample <- ari_std %>%
    filter(indicator %in% inds) %>%
    group_by(sample, group, line, label) %>%
    summarise(composite = mean(aligned), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(group = relevel(droplevels(group), ref = "CTRL"))
  fit <- lm(composite ~ group + line, data = per_sample)
  co  <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  ci  <- confint(fit)
  rows <- paste0("group", treatments)
  data.frame(set       = nm,
             n_ind     = length(inds),
             group     = treatments,
             estimate  = co[rows, "Estimate"],
             lower     = ci[rows, 1],
             upper     = ci[rows, 2],
             p_nominal = co[rows, "Pr(>|t|)"])
}))
 
## Directional consistency: how many indicators point the slow-aging way?
concord <- bind_rows(lapply(names(composite_sets), function(nm) {
  ind_eff %>%
    filter(indicator %in% composite_sets[[nm]]) %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(n_slow  = sum(std_est > 0),
              n_total = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(set = nm,
           sign_p = mapply(function(k, n)
             binom.test(k, n, 0.5, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
             n_slow, n_total))
}))
 
comp_eff <- comp_eff %>%
  left_join(concord, by = c("set", "group")) %>%
  mutate(
    label = factor(full_names[group], levels = full_names[treatments]),
    set   = factor(set, levels = names(composite_sets)),
    call  = case_when(
      lower > 0                                        ~ "Coordinated, slow-aging direction",
      upper < 0                                        ~ "Coordinated, opposite direction",
      lower > -equiv_margin & upper < equiv_margin     ~ "No detectable response",
      TRUE                                             ~ "Uncertain (wide CI)"
    ),
    ci_width = upper - lower
  )
 
write.csv(comp_eff, file.path(out_dir, "ARI_composite_effects.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
 
message("\nComposite ARI effects (SD units, + = slow-aging direction):")
print(comp_eff %>%
        transmute(set, compound = label,
                  estimate = round(estimate, 2),
                  CI = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", lower, upper),
                  slow_dir = paste0(n_slow, "/", n_total),
                  call),
      row.names = FALSE)
```

#8 -- Figure 1, per indicator forest plot 

```{r}
## Compound order top-to-bottom matches Table 1
y_order <- rev(full_names[treatments])
 
strip_lab <- setNames(
  paste0(ari_info$indicator, "\n(slow-aging: ",
         ifelse(ari_info$direction > 0, "up", "down"), ")"),
  ari_info$indicator)
 
p_forest <- ggplot(ind_eff,
                   aes(x = std_est, y = factor(label, levels = y_order),
                       colour = label)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -equiv_margin, xmax = equiv_margin,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey92") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbar(orientation = "y", aes(xmin = std_lower, xmax = std_upper),
                 width = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = nominal_sig), size = 1.8, fill = "white") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = group_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 21),
                     labels = c(`TRUE` = "p < 0.05 (nominal)",
                                `FALSE` = "Not significant"),
                     name = NULL) +
  facet_grid(. ~ indicator, scales = "free_x",
             labeller = labeller(indicator = strip_lab)) +
  labs(x = "Effect vs vehicle (SD units; + = slow-aging direction)",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_fig +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.spacing.x = unit(0.4, "cm"))

p_forest
 
save_fig(p_forest, "FigS_ARI_forest_standardized",
         w = 1.15 * length(ari_levels) + 1.2, h = 3.4)
```

```{r}
                     name = NULL) +
  facet_grid(. ~ indicator, scales = "free_x",
             labeller = labeller(indicator = native_lab)) +

        panel.spacing.x = unit(0.4, "cm"))

p_native
 
save_fig(p_native, "FigS_ARI_forest_native_units",
         w = 1.15 * length(ari_levels) + 1.2, h = 3.4)
 
## ---- 10. Figure: composite ARI effect per compound --------------------------
set_lab <- setNames(
  sprintf("%s (n = %d)", names(composite_sets), lengths(composite_sets)),
  names(composite_sets))
 
p_comp <- ggplot(comp_eff,
                 aes(x = estimate, y = factor(label, levels = y_order),
                     colour = label)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -equiv_margin, xmax = equiv_margin,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey92") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbar(orientation = "y", aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), width = 0, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  ## indicators in the slow-aging direction, printed just outside each panel
  geom_text(aes(x = Inf, label = paste0(n_slow, "/", n_total)),
            hjust = -0.3, size = 2.6, colour = "black", family = base_font) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = group_cols, guide = "none") +
  facet_grid(. ~ set, labeller = labeller(set = set_lab)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Composite ARI shift vs vehicle\n(mean SD units; + = slow-aging direction)",
       y = NULL,
       caption = "Right of each panel: indicators shifted in the slow-aging direction") +
  theme_fig +
  theme(panel.spacing.x = unit(1.1, "cm"),
        plot.margin     = margin(5.5, 28, 5.5, 5.5),
        plot.caption    = element_text(size = 7, colour = "grey30"))

p_comp
 
save_fig(p_comp, "FigS_ARI_composite", w = 5.6, h = 3.1)
```
